dedupe_keys.name: ediaqi multi instrument indoor and ambient air pollution dataset controlled room croatia

description: A multi-instrument dataset of indoor and outdoor air pollution from a controlled experimental room in Croatia, produced in the Horizon EDIAQI project by teams from the Lisbon Council, the Institute for Anthropological Research in Zagreb, Ascalia and the Ruđer Bošković Institute, and described in a 2025 Scientific Data article. It integrates low-cost sensors, reference-grade devices and auxiliary systems to track particulate matter, black carbon and volatile organic compounds, plus indoor events. Experiments simulated cooking, cleaning, human presence and ventilation. There are 19 subsets, each for a parameter or sensor provider, measured from 11 to 31 October 2024 at intervals of one second to 15 minutes; one provider had 16 sensors. The Zenodo record (created 29 January 2025) has a 50 MB data archive and a spreadsheet describing measurements, and the collocation code is on GitHub. Licence: CC BY 4.0; free. Coverage: a single room, three weeks, so results do not describe whole buildings or seasons. Useful for sensor calibration, ventilation and indoor air quality model validation and health-oriented building planning; related records are not yet linked.
